summary: Add the column (metadata only), backfill in batches, deploy state-only.

sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN loyalty_score integer
WITH batch AS (SELECT id FROM account_user WHERE loyalty_score IS NULL LIMIT 10000) UPDATE account_user SET loyalty_score = 0 FROM batch WHERE account_user.id = batch.id
